a new Cycles F-modifier starts at mode REPEAT both ways with 0 cycles (0 = forever), though the registered default of the modes is NONE
a modifier added after the scene was evaluated (frame_set above) is ignored by frame_set: frame 61 still reads the held last key, though fcurve.evaluate(61) already gives the repeat
after action.update_tag() the 48-frame cycle repeats: frame 61 equals frame 13 and frame 73 equals frame 25 (x = 2), and frames before the first key repeat too

once the material is on an object in the scene, frame_set animates it: the original input and the evaluated copy both read the keyed value
